dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the Millelith.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: "While rock stays hard, the mountain shall never fail; while the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail."

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: The Millelith are under the Liyue Qixing's command. You could say we're the city's public security officers.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: We're here to handle minor matters such as theft and other disturbances of the peace. We also stand ready as Liyue's firm shield in the case of a monster attack.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: Never hesitate to call on us if you need assistance of any kind.
